answer: I would stop farms with passport NFC chip proof, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 554 fakes spends 7202 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The basalt test is the live device, the falcon test is the locked stake, and the terrace test is the graded history no template can fake. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
